scope: Historical external development matches; no fresh test and no organizer result

spec.ordered_features: raw collective features at +/-1,3,5 s plus future-minus-past at those lags
spec.d_inputs: player motion/shape only; no ball, owner, event or target fields
spec.augmentation: clean + fixed-seed player-slot dropout; equal source and match weights
spec.missingness: train-only median/std normalization plus explicit finite-value masks for neural inputs
spec.attribution: fixed pooled multisource_eval HGB conditional H/A for every D head and fold
spec.provider_holdout_scope: D head only; fixed H/A backbone has seen training matches from all providers
spec.evaluation: existing development matches only; no fresh confirmation or public-label selection
spec.selection: equal-provider mean official spell F1 on D-head provider-holdout rows; tie macro F1; baseline remains eligible

boundary_limitations: SkillCorner D intervals have X margins: zero eligible reference boundaries. Its official boundary zeros are unavailable evidence, not measured timing failure; inspect n_gt and d_boundary_evaluation_supported. No cross-provider boundary mean is computed.

selection.selection_rule: equal-provider mean official spell F1 on D-head provider-holdout rows; tie macro F1; baseline remains eligible
